prompts.01-evidence-to-decisions: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a simple, friendly editorial illustration for a Medium/Substack article about GitHub Manager. The attached diagrams are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match the white paper, black hand-drawn pen outlines, blue/indigo/purple handwritten headings, lavender/light-blue marker highlights, expressive semantic doodles and generous whitespace. Make this MUCH simpler than the references: four large illustrated scenes across a landscape page, flowing arrows, minimal legible text, no dense architecture boxes or paragraphs. Exact title: 'From repositories to decisions you can review'. Scene 1: GitHub Octocat beside a small stack of repository folders, label '1 · Find your repositories'. Scene 2: a README page with two highlighted purpose passages and a few keyword chips, label '2 · Keep the purpose evidence'. Scene 3: magnifying glass over canonical label cards next to a small friendly AI robot, label '3 · Match approved concepts'. Cards say 'Projects', 'Topics', 'Tags'. Scene 4: a person at a laptop reviewing a suggestion with approve/edit/reject symbols, label '4 · You review the suggestions'. A small handwritten note under scene 3 says 'Domains derive through Projects'. Bottom highlight, exact text: 'GitHub owns the facts. You own the organization.' Small footer: 'GitHub Manager'. These are current product concepts, not an autonomous agent. Draw no cloud services, vector index, score chart, tool loop, invented JSON schema or additional claims. Every label must be spelled correctly. Aim for clear wide editorial composition, readable at ordinary article width.
prompts.02-remember-the-analysis: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a SIMPLE editorial hand-drawn sketchnote matching the attached GitHub Manager STYLE REFERENCES: white paper, expressive black ink doodles, blue/indigo/purple handwritten headings, soft marker accents, big recognizable icons and clear arrows. Minimal text and generous whitespace, not a dense flowchart. Exact title: 'Remember the analysis. Review the changes.' Start with a repository folder and a receipt ledger labelled 'Check the analysis receipt'. Split into two clear illustrated routes: upper route with a NEW receipt, a small friendly robot and a bounded ticket; exact labels 'New repository', 'Bounded AI analysis', 'Save the receipt'. Lower route with an ALREADY ANALYZED receipt, gears and stored evidence cards; exact labels 'Already analyzed', 'Reconcile locally', 'Review suggestions'. At right, both routes reach a person reviewing a clipboard labelled 'You decide'. A separate small bottom vignette shows that same person pressing a refresh icon, exact labels 'Explicit re-analysis' and 'Reason + reviewed budget'. Dashed arrow from that vignette points toward the AI route to indicate deliberate authorization. Bottom highlight exact text: 'NO_MATCH is a completed result.' Add one small supporting note: 'A taxonomy change does not automatically authorize another paid call.' Small footer 'GitHub Manager'. Do not depict every already-analyzed item as auto-retried, imply the LLM remembers conversations, add cost-saving percentages or claim automatic paid re-analysis. Keep all text highly legible.
prompts.03-accountable-model-calls: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a simple editorial illustrated explainer matching the attached GitHub Manager STYLE REFERENCES: white paper, black pen doodles, expressive blue/indigo/purple handwritten headings, soft lavender/light-blue marker accents, minimal readable text, generous whitespace. Avoid dense boxed block diagrams. Exact title 'Make each model call accountable'. Four large scenes left to right with hand-drawn arrows: (1) token ruler beside a small context document and schema braces, heading 'Count', sublabel 'Include the schema'; (2) coin vault and reservation ticket, heading 'Reserve', sublabel 'Hold a conservative maximum'; (3) friendly robot making a structured decision, heading 'Generate', sublabel 'Use a finite call allowance'; (4) usage receipt and small ledger, heading 'Record', sublabel 'Settle known usage'. Below the main path draw a small lock holding coins with exact text 'Unknown usage stays reserved'. Separate a small reset eraser from the locked vault with exact note 'Reset does not refill the budget'. One blue/purple highlighted sentence at bottom, exact text 'Fixed limits and adaptive budgets share the cumulative cap.' Small footer 'GitHub Manager'. Do not add numerical costs, invoice claims, unlimited adaptive calls, hidden retries, cloud services or model-specific pricing. All text must be spelled correctly and remain readable at normal article width.
